results.title: A Berber organization denounces almost 50 civilians killed in a jihadist massacre in eastern Mali
results.snippet: A Berber organization alerts about the massacre of 48 civilians in Tagadayat, attributed to the EIGS, which causes massive displacements and urgent aid

results.title: Attack by Islamic State-affiliated group in Mali kills 48 people
results.snippet: BAMAKO, Mali (AP) — A weekend attack by militants affiliated to the Islamic State group killed 48 people in the Ménaka region of eastern Mali,
